name: GraphRAG entity resolution demo
description: Four identity models show merge post-processing provenance and reversal.

name: 1 - Physical canonical merge
description: Delete a duplicate node after moving its mentions and supported Fact into a survivor.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and create stable identifier constraints

name: Step 2 - Create duplicate entities
description: Idempotently create two chunks that initially support two separate Drug identities and Facts.
query:
// Stable IDs make extraction ingestion safe to retry.
MERGE (d1:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'}) SET d1.title = 'Paracetamol study'
MERGE (d2:Document {documentId: 'DOC-2'}) SET d2.title = 'Acetaminophen study'
MERGE (c1:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'}) SET c1.text = 'Paracetamol treats fever.'
MERGE (c2:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-2-C1'}) SET c2.text = 'Acetaminophen treats fever.'
MERGE (para:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
SET para.name = 'Paracetamol', para.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001'
MERGE (acet:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET acet.name = 'Acetaminophen', acet.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001'
MERGE (fever:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}) SET fever.name = 'Fever'
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f2.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (c1)-[:PART_OF]->(d1)
MERGE (c2)-[:PART_OF]->(d2)
MERGE (c1)-[mp:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'M-PARA'}]->(para)
SET mp.surfaceForm = 'Paracetamol', mp.start = 0, mp.end = 11,
    mp.confidence = 0.96, mp.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (c1)-[mf1:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-1'}]->(fever)
SET mf1.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf1.start = 19, mf1.end = 24,
    mf1.confidence = 0.97, mf1.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (c2)-[ma:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'M-ACET'}]->(acet)
SET ma.surfaceForm = 'Acetaminophen', ma.start = 0, ma.end = 13,
    ma.confidence = 0.98, ma.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (c2)-[mf2:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-2'}]->(fever)
SET mf2.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf2.start = 21, mf2.end = 26,
    mf2.confidence = 0.97, mf2.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (f2)-[:SUBJECT]->(acet)
MERGE (f2)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (c1)-[s1:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-1'}]->(f1)
SET s1.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA', s1.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-1',
    s1.confidence = 0.94, s1.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (c2)-[s2:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-2'}]->(f2)
SET s2.subjectMentionId = 'M-ACET', s2.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-2',
    s2.confidence = 0.95, s2.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever) SET r1.supportCount = 1
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever) SET r2.supportCount = 1;

name: Step 3 - Display before resolution
description: Show the two Drug entities their source graph and their duplicate query relationships.

name: Step 4 - Inspect the candidate
description: Find two Drug nodes sharing a supplied trusted concept identifier.
query:
// Candidate generation must be bounded in production.
MATCH (left:Drug), (right:Drug)
WHERE elementId(left) < elementId(right)
  AND left.standardConceptId = right.standardConceptId
RETURN left.entityId AS leftId, left.name AS leftName,
       right.entityId AS rightId, right.name AS rightName,
       left.standardConceptId AS matchingSignal;

name: Step 5 - Apply the physical merge
description: Move source links and Fact support into Acetaminophen then delete the duplicate node.
query:
// Preserve occurrence metadata while moving direct mention relationships.
MATCH (loser:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (winner:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:MENTIONS]->(loser)
WITH c, winner, old, properties(old) AS occurrence
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[m:MENTIONS {mentionId: occurrence.mentionId}]->(winner)
SET m = occurrence;

// The two claims now have the same canonical identity: move source support.
MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (canonicalFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(oldFact)
WITH c, oldFact, canonicalFact, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(canonicalFact)
SET s = support;

MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
DETACH DELETE oldFact;

// Keep an alias on the survivor but discard the duplicate identity.
MATCH (loser:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (winner:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET winner.aliases = ['Paracetamol'], winner.resolutionStatus = 'CANONICAL'
DETACH DELETE loser;

// Refresh only the affected native query projection.
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})-[:SUBJECT]->(drug:Drug),
      (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication:Indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (:Chunk)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(s) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

name: Step 6 - Display the merged graph
description: Show one canonical Drug one Fact and one native relationship with two supports.

name: Step 7 - Query and cite
description: Use the native graph then trace its canonical Fact to both source chunks.
query:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[s:SUPPORTS]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
MATCH (c)-[mention:MENTIONS]->(drug)
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, c.text AS excerpt,
       mention.surfaceForm AS extractedName, s.confidence AS factConfidence
ORDER BY documentId;

name: Step 8 - Inspect reversibility
description: Confirm that the losing canonical node and its original Fact no longer exist.

name: 2 - Mentions to canonical entities
description: Retain extraction occurrences and change only their current canonical resolution.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain document mention entity and Fact IDs.

name: Step 2 - Create mentions and duplicate entities
description: Idempotently keep each extraction occurrence separate from its initially resolved canonical Entity.
query:
// Mentions preserve source truth; RESOLVED_TO is current identity state.
MERGE (d1:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'}) SET d1.title = 'Paracetamol study'
MERGE (d2:Document {documentId: 'DOC-2'}) SET d2.title = 'Acetaminophen study'
MERGE (c1:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'}) SET c1.text = 'Paracetamol treats fever.'
MERGE (c2:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-2-C1'}) SET c2.text = 'Acetaminophen treats fever.'
MERGE (m1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})
SET m1.surfaceForm = 'Paracetamol', m1.proposedType = 'Drug', m1.start = 0,
    m1.end = 11, m1.confidence = 0.96, m1.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (m2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-ACET'})
SET m2.surfaceForm = 'Acetaminophen', m2.proposedType = 'Drug', m2.start = 0,
    m2.end = 13, m2.confidence = 0.98, m2.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (mf1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-1'})
SET mf1.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf1.proposedType = 'Indication', mf1.start = 19, mf1.end = 24
MERGE (mf2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-2'})
SET mf2.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf2.proposedType = 'Indication', mf2.start = 21, mf2.end = 26
MERGE (para:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
SET para.name = 'Paracetamol', para.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001'
MERGE (acet:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET acet.name = 'Acetaminophen', acet.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001'
MERGE (fever:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}) SET fever.name = 'Fever'
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f2.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (c1)-[:PART_OF]->(d1)
MERGE (c2)-[:PART_OF]->(d2)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m1)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf1)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m2)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf2)
MERGE (m1)-[rm1:RESOLVED_TO]->(para) SET rm1.method = 'initial-extraction'
MERGE (m2)-[rm2:RESOLVED_TO]->(acet) SET rm2.method = 'initial-extraction'
MERGE (mf1)-[rf1:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf1.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (mf2)-[rf2:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf2.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (m1)-[candidate:CANDIDATE_FOR]->(acet)
SET candidate.score = 0.99, candidate.method = 'trusted-identifier', candidate.status = 'PROPOSED'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (f2)-[:SUBJECT]->(acet)
MERGE (f2)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (c1)-[s1:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-1'}]->(f1)
SET s1.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA', s1.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-1', s1.confidence = 0.94
MERGE (c2)-[s2:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-2'}]->(f2)
SET s2.subjectMentionId = 'M-ACET', s2.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-2', s2.confidence = 0.95
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever) SET r1.supportCount = 1
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever) SET r2.supportCount = 1;

name: Step 3 - Display before resolution
description: Show immutable mentions current resolutions candidate evidence Facts and query relationships.

name: Step 4 - Accept and materialize the merge
description: Resolve the Paracetamol mention to the survivor and consolidate the affected Fact projection.
query:
// Replace current resolution without changing the extracted mention.
MATCH (m:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})-[old:RESOLVED_TO]->(:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (winner:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
DELETE old
MERGE (m)-[resolved:RESOLVED_TO]->(winner)
SET resolved.method = 'trusted-identifier', resolved.resolverVersion = 'demo-resolver-v1'
WITH m, winner
MATCH (m)-[candidate:CANDIDATE_FOR]->(winner)
SET candidate.status = 'ACCEPTED';

// Retain the old canonical ID as a redirect for correction and old links.
MATCH (loser:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (winner:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET loser.resolutionStatus = 'MERGED', winner.aliases = ['Paracetamol']
MERGE (loser)-[:MERGED_INTO {method: 'trusted-identifier'}]->(winner);

// Canonical endpoints collide, so consolidate the supported Facts.
MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (canonicalFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(oldFact)
WITH c, oldFact, canonicalFact, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(canonicalFact)
SET s = support;

MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
DETACH DELETE oldFact;

MATCH (:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[old:TREATS]->()
DELETE old;

MATCH (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})-[:SUBJECT]->(drug:Drug),
      (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication:Indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (:Chunk)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(s) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

name: Step 5 - Display the merged graph
description: Show that both source mentions now resolve to one canonical Drug.

name: Step 6 - Query and cite
description: Return one native relationship with both source surface forms and documents.
query:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[s:SUPPORTS]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mention:EntityMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(drug)
WHERE mention.proposedType = 'Drug'
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, c.text AS excerpt,
       mention.surfaceForm AS extractedName, s.confidence AS factConfidence
ORDER BY documentId;

name: Step 7 - Split the identities
description: Restore the original current resolution and separate the affected Fact support.
query:
// The mention tells us which observation belongs to the restored entity.
MATCH (m:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})-[old:RESOLVED_TO]->(:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
DELETE old
MERGE (m)-[resolved:RESOLVED_TO]->(para)
SET resolved.method = 'manual-correction', resolved.resolverVersion = 'demo-resolver-v2'
WITH m, para
MATCH (m)-[candidate:CANDIDATE_FOR]->(:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET candidate.status = 'REJECTED';

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[redirect:MERGED_INTO]->(:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
DELETE redirect
SET para.resolutionStatus = 'CANONICAL'
REMOVE para.mergedAt;

MATCH (acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'})
SET acet.aliases = []
MERGE (para:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
  ON MATCH SET para.name = 'Paracetamol'
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
WITH f1, acet
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
WHERE old.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA'
WITH c, f1, f2, acet, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(f1)
SET s = support;

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}),
      (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever)
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever)
SET r1.supportCount = 1, r2.supportCount = 1;

name: Step 8 - Display the corrected split
description: Show two canonical Drugs again while all original mention data remains intact.

name: 3 - Identity clusters
description: Resolve document mentions and structured source records into a stable cross-system identity container.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain source record cluster mention entity and Fact IDs.

name: Step 2 - Create two identity clusters
description: Idempotently place structured records and document mentions in two initially separate identity clusters.
query:
// Source records keep their source-system identity and values.
MERGE (terminology:SourceRecord:DrugRecord {recordId: 'TERM-ACET'})
SET terminology.sourceSystem = 'Terminology', terminology.sourceId = 'T-100',
    terminology.name = 'Acetaminophen', terminology.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001', terminology.trustRank = 1
MERGE (regulatory:SourceRecord:DrugRecord {recordId: 'REG-PARA'})
SET regulatory.sourceSystem = 'RegulatoryCatalog', regulatory.sourceId = 'R-900',
    regulatory.name = 'Paracetamol', regulatory.standardConceptId = 'DEMO-DRUG-001', regulatory.trustRank = 2
MERGE (clusterA:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'}) SET clusterA.status = 'ACTIVE'
MERGE (clusterP:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-PARA'}) SET clusterP.status = 'ACTIVE'
MERGE (acet:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET acet.name = 'Acetaminophen', acet.canonicalNameSourceRecordId = 'TERM-ACET'
MERGE (para:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
SET para.name = 'Paracetamol', para.canonicalNameSourceRecordId = 'REG-PARA'
MERGE (fever:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}) SET fever.name = 'Fever'
MERGE (d1:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'}) SET d1.title = 'Paracetamol study'
MERGE (d2:Document {documentId: 'DOC-2'}) SET d2.title = 'Acetaminophen study'
MERGE (c1:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'}) SET c1.text = 'Paracetamol treats fever.'
MERGE (c2:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-2-C1'}) SET c2.text = 'Acetaminophen treats fever.'
MERGE (m1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})
SET m1.surfaceForm = 'Paracetamol', m1.proposedType = 'Drug', m1.start = 0, m1.end = 11
MERGE (m2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-ACET'})
SET m2.surfaceForm = 'Acetaminophen', m2.proposedType = 'Drug', m2.start = 0, m2.end = 13
MERGE (mf1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-1'})
SET mf1.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf1.proposedType = 'Indication', mf1.start = 19, mf1.end = 24
MERGE (mf2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-2'})
SET mf2.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf2.proposedType = 'Indication', mf2.start = 21, mf2.end = 26
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f2.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (terminology)-[mt:MEMBER_OF]->(clusterA) SET mt.method = 'source-import'
MERGE (regulatory)-[mr:MEMBER_OF]->(clusterP) SET mr.method = 'source-import'
MERGE (m1)-[mm1:MEMBER_OF]->(clusterP) SET mm1.method = 'initial-name-match'
MERGE (m2)-[mm2:MEMBER_OF]->(clusterA) SET mm2.method = 'initial-name-match'
MERGE (clusterA)-[:MATERIALIZES]->(acet)
MERGE (clusterP)-[:MATERIALIZES]->(para)
MERGE (c1)-[:PART_OF]->(d1)
MERGE (c2)-[:PART_OF]->(d2)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m1)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf1)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m2)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf2)
MERGE (mf1)-[rf1:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf1.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (mf2)-[rf2:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf2.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (f2)-[:SUBJECT]->(acet)
MERGE (f2)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (c1)-[s1:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-1'}]->(f1)
SET s1.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA', s1.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-1', s1.confidence = 0.94
MERGE (c2)-[s2:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-2'}]->(f2)
SET s2.subjectMentionId = 'M-ACET', s2.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-2', s2.confidence = 0.95
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever) SET r1.supportCount = 1
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever) SET r2.supportCount = 1;

name: Step 3 - Display before cluster merge
description: Show the independently addressable records mentions clusters and materialized entities.

name: Step 4 - Find cross-system candidates
description: Use a shared structured identifier to find records assigned to different clusters.
query:
// A real pipeline blocks candidates by type tenant and other constraints.
MATCH (left:SourceRecord)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(leftCluster:IdentityCluster),
      (right:SourceRecord)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(rightCluster:IdentityCluster)
WHERE elementId(left) < elementId(right)
  AND left.standardConceptId = right.standardConceptId
  AND leftCluster <> rightCluster
RETURN left.sourceSystem AS leftSystem, left.name AS leftName,
       right.sourceSystem AS rightSystem, right.name AS rightName,
       left.standardConceptId AS matchingSignal,
       leftCluster.clusterId AS leftCluster, rightCluster.clusterId AS rightCluster;

name: Step 5 - Merge the identity clusters
description: Move source membership into one cluster and rebuild its canonical Fact projection.
query:
// Move members but retain the old cluster as a stable redirect.
MATCH (oldCluster:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-PARA'}),
      (winner:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'})
MATCH (member)-[old:MEMBER_OF]->(oldCluster)
WITH member, oldCluster, winner, old, properties(old) AS membership
DELETE old
MERGE (member)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(winner)
SET m = membership;

MATCH (oldCluster:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-PARA'}),
      (winner:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'}),
      (loser:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (survivor:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
MATCH (oldCluster)-[projection:MATERIALIZES]->(loser)
DELETE projection
SET oldCluster.status = 'MERGED', loser.resolutionStatus = 'MERGED',
    survivor.aliases = ['Paracetamol'],
    survivor.canonicalNameSourceRecordId = 'TERM-ACET'
MERGE (oldCluster)-[:MERGED_INTO]->(winner)
MERGE (loser)-[:MERGED_INTO]->(survivor);

// Resolution changed a Fact endpoint: consolidate its support.
MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (canonicalFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(oldFact)
WITH c, oldFact, canonicalFact, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(canonicalFact)
SET s = support;

MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
DETACH DELETE oldFact;

MATCH (:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[old:TREATS]->()
DELETE old;

MATCH (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})-[:SUBJECT]->(drug:Drug),
      (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication:Indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (:Chunk)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(s) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

name: Step 6 - Display the merged cluster
description: Show two records and two mentions grouped by one cluster that materializes one canonical Drug.

name: Step 7 - Query and cite through the cluster
description: Return the canonical query edge with each mention source record and supporting document.
query:
MATCH (cluster:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'})-[:MATERIALIZES]->(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[s:SUPPORTS]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mention:EntityMention)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(cluster)
OPTIONAL MATCH (record:SourceRecord)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(cluster)
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, mention.surfaceForm AS extractedName,
       collect(DISTINCT record.sourceSystem + ':' + record.sourceId) AS structuredRecords,
       s.confidence AS factConfidence
ORDER BY documentId;

name: Step 8 - Split the cluster
description: Move the Paracetamol record and mention back to their retained cluster and rebuild affected Facts.
query:
// Explicit memberships identify exactly which records return to the split cluster.
MATCH (winner:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'}),
      (restored:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-PARA'})
MATCH (member)-[old:MEMBER_OF]->(winner)
WHERE member.recordId = 'REG-PARA' OR member.mentionId = 'M-PARA'
WITH member, winner, restored, old, properties(old) AS membership
DELETE old
MERGE (member)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(restored)
SET m = membership;

MATCH (restored:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-PARA'})-[clusterRedirect:MERGED_INTO]->(:IdentityCluster {clusterId: 'CLUSTER-ACET'}),
      (loser:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[entityRedirect:MERGED_INTO]->(survivor:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
DELETE clusterRedirect, entityRedirect
SET restored.status = 'ACTIVE', loser.resolutionStatus = 'CANONICAL', survivor.aliases = []
MERGE (restored)-[:MATERIALIZES]->(loser);

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'})
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
WITH f1
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
WHERE old.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA'
WITH c, f1, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(f1)
SET s = support;

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}),
      (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever)
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever)
SET r1.supportCount = 1, r2.supportCount = 1;

name: Step 9 - Display the restored clusters
description: Show the split while preserving every original structured record and document mention.

name: 4 - Audited resolution decisions
description: Keep durable merge rationale and supersession while materializing a fast current state.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain source mention entity Fact and decision IDs.

name: Step 2 - Create a proposed decision
description: Idempotently create two identities their source graph and an unresolved audited merge proposal.
query:
// The decision records rationale; current state remains separately materialized.
MERGE (d1:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'}) SET d1.title = 'Paracetamol study'
MERGE (d2:Document {documentId: 'DOC-2'}) SET d2.title = 'Acetaminophen study'
MERGE (c1:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'}) SET c1.text = 'Paracetamol treats fever.'
MERGE (c2:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-2-C1'}) SET c2.text = 'Acetaminophen treats fever.'
MERGE (m1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})
SET m1.surfaceForm = 'Paracetamol', m1.proposedType = 'Drug', m1.start = 0, m1.end = 11
MERGE (m2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-ACET'})
SET m2.surfaceForm = 'Acetaminophen', m2.proposedType = 'Drug', m2.start = 0, m2.end = 13
MERGE (mf1:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-1'})
SET mf1.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf1.proposedType = 'Indication', mf1.start = 19, mf1.end = 24
MERGE (mf2:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-FEVER-2'})
SET mf2.surfaceForm = 'fever', mf2.proposedType = 'Indication', mf2.start = 21, mf2.end = 26
MERGE (para:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}) SET para.name = 'Paracetamol'
MERGE (acet:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}) SET acet.name = 'Acetaminophen'
MERGE (fever:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}) SET fever.name = 'Fever'
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f2.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (decision:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-MERGE-001'})
ON CREATE SET decision.action = 'MERGE', decision.status = 'PROPOSED',
              decision.method = 'ensemble', decision.resolverVersion = 'demo-resolver-v1',
              decision.explanation = 'Trusted concept identifier agrees; names are known synonyms'
MERGE (c1)-[:PART_OF]->(d1)
MERGE (c2)-[:PART_OF]->(d2)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m1)
MERGE (c1)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf1)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(m2)
MERGE (c2)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mf2)
MERGE (m1)-[rm1:RESOLVED_TO]->(para) SET rm1.method = 'initial-extraction'
MERGE (m2)-[rm2:RESOLVED_TO]->(acet) SET rm2.method = 'initial-extraction'
MERGE (mf1)-[rf1:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf1.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (mf2)-[rf2:RESOLVED_TO]->(fever) SET rf2.method = 'exact-name'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (f2)-[:SUBJECT]->(acet)
MERGE (f2)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
MERGE (c1)-[s1:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-1'}]->(f1)
SET s1.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA', s1.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-1', s1.confidence = 0.94
MERGE (c2)-[s2:SUPPORTS {supportId: 'SUPPORT-2'}]->(f2)
SET s2.subjectMentionId = 'M-ACET', s2.objectMentionId = 'M-FEVER-2', s2.confidence = 0.95
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever) SET r1.supportCount = 1
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever) SET r2.supportCount = 1
MERGE (decision)-[:SOURCE]->(para)
MERGE (decision)-[:SELECTED]->(acet)
MERGE (decision)-[considered:CONSIDERED]->(acet)
SET considered.score = 0.99, considered.identifierMatch = true, considered.nameSimilarity = 0.62;

name: Step 3 - Review the proposal
description: Inspect the proposed action selected survivor explanation and scored alternative.
query:
MATCH (decision:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-MERGE-001'})-[r]->(entity:Entity)
RETURN decision.decisionId AS decisionId, decision.action AS action,
       decision.status AS status, type(r) AS role, entity.entityId AS entityId,
       r.score AS score, r.identifierMatch AS identifierMatch,
       decision.explanation AS explanation;

name: Step 4 - Accept and materialize the decision
description: Record human acceptance then update current identity Fact support and native projection.
query:
// Decision history is durable; these relationships are the fast current state.
MATCH (decision:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-MERGE-001'}),
      (m:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})-[old:RESOLVED_TO]->(para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
SET decision.status = 'ACCEPTED', decision.decidedBy = 'demo-reviewer',
    decision.decidedAt = '2026-09-11T10:00:00Z'
DELETE old
MERGE (m)-[resolved:RESOLVED_TO]->(acet)
SET resolved.decisionId = decision.decisionId
MERGE (para)-[redirect:MERGED_INTO]->(acet)
SET redirect.decisionId = decision.decisionId
SET para.resolutionStatus = 'MERGED', acet.aliases = ['Paracetamol'];

// Apply downstream post-processing only after the decision is accepted.
MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (canonicalFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(oldFact)
WITH c, oldFact, canonicalFact, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(canonicalFact)
SET s = support;

MATCH (oldFact:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
DETACH DELETE oldFact;

MATCH (:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[old:TREATS]->()
DELETE old;

MATCH (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})-[:SUBJECT]->(drug:Drug),
      (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication:Indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (:Chunk)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(s) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

name: Step 5 - Display accepted state
description: Show durable rationale beside the materialized canonical identity and query graph.

name: Step 6 - Query and cite
description: Return one application relationship with both supporting documents and its merge decision.
query:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[s:SUPPORTS]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mention:EntityMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(drug)
OPTIONAL MATCH (loser:Entity)-[redirect:MERGED_INTO]->(drug)
OPTIONAL MATCH (decision:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: redirect.decisionId})
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, mention.surfaceForm AS extractedName,
       decision.decisionId AS mergeDecision, decision.explanation AS rationale,
       s.confidence AS factConfidence
ORDER BY documentId;

name: Step 7 - Supersede and split
description: Create a correction decision restore the old identity and separate downstream Fact support.
query:
// Never overwrite the accepted decision: supersede it with a new event.
MATCH (merge:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-MERGE-001'}),
      (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})
MERGE (split:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-SPLIT-001'})
ON CREATE SET split.action = 'SPLIT', split.status = 'ACCEPTED',
              split.method = 'human-review', split.resolverVersion = 'demo-resolver-v2',
              split.explanation = 'Demo correction restores the pre-merge identities',
              split.decidedBy = 'demo-reviewer', split.decidedAt = '2026-09-11T10:30:00Z'
MERGE (split)-[:SOURCE]->(para)
MERGE (split)-[:SELECTED]->(para)
MERGE (split)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(merge)
SET merge.status = 'SUPERSEDED';

MATCH (split:ResolutionDecision {decisionId: 'DEC-SPLIT-001'}),
      (m:EntityMention {mentionId: 'M-PARA'})-[old:RESOLVED_TO]->(:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'})-[redirect:MERGED_INTO]->(acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'})
DELETE old, redirect
MERGE (m)-[resolved:RESOLVED_TO]->(para)
SET resolved.decisionId = split.decisionId
SET para.resolutionStatus = 'CANONICAL', acet.aliases = [];

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'})
MERGE (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
SET f1.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f1)-[:SUBJECT]->(para)
MERGE (f1)-[:OBJECT]->(fever)
WITH f1
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[old:SUPPORTS]->(:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
WHERE old.subjectMentionId = 'M-PARA'
WITH c, f1, old, properties(old) AS support
DELETE old
MERGE (c)-[s:SUPPORTS {supportId: support.supportId}]->(f1)
SET s = support;

MATCH (para:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL'}),
      (acet:Entity {entityId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN'}),
      (fever:Entity {entityId: 'IND-FEVER'}),
      (f1:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-PARACETAMOL|TREATS|IND-FEVER'}),
      (f2:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ACETAMINOPHEN|TREATS|IND-FEVER'})
MERGE (para)-[r1:TREATS {factId: f1.factId}]->(fever)
MERGE (acet)-[r2:TREATS {factId: f2.factId}]->(fever)
SET r1.supportCount = 1, r2.supportCount = 1;

description: Follow the correction to the accepted merge decision it superseded.

description: Show the restored application graph while both merge and correction decisions remain.
